Name: Darker Fences
Author: kaznej
Description:
this mod was made to match my [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7367]darker paths and floors[/url][/b] mod. downloading it is not mandatory, but maybe do if you'd like a matching set!


~ how to install:

1. download the latest version of[b] [url=https://smapi.io/]smapi[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url]﻿﻿[/b]
2. extract the file and drop it into your /mods folder
3. you're done!

~ config options:
each fence has two recolors: A and B. defaults to A. the previews are included in the [i]previews [/i]folder. 
when you open the game, it will generate a [b].config[/b] file. choose the recolor you want for each fence and save.

--

check out my furniture recolor mod if you'd like a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22584]toned down version of the vanilla furniture[/url]﻿.

Downloads.Description: darker recolor of vanilla fences to match my darker paths and floors mod.
